responsibility: This file implements the D language hook for gimplification, lowering D-specific or D-sensitive tree forms into GIMPLE-friendly expressions before the middle end proceeds. It handles empty aggregate copies, explicit view conversions for aggregate assignments, bit-field conversions in unary/binary/assignment expressions, left-to-right evaluation of call arguments required by D semantics, constructor addressability, and lowering of the custom `UNSIGNED_RSHIFT_EXPR` tree code.
